summary: Two skiers in Coin Slot Couloir on Mount Royal witnessed a snow collapse near skiable terrain and became stuck, fearing they would trigger an avalanche; rescue call ~2:30 p.m.; a 9-person Summit County Rescue Group team evacuated them ~7:30 p.m., uninjured.
notes: Source: Unofficial Networks 2021-01-05 Summit County rescues retelling (opened run 532), citing the Summit Daily. Article text typo '1/3/20' corrected to 2021-01-03 via URL slug + Sunday weekday verification. Cross-line lead from run 499 re-confirmed. Genuinely new: zero 2021-01-03 Mount Royal rows (only Mount Royal rows were ids 568, 2742).
